hooks.name: Task Progress Tracker
hooks.description: On any tasks.md save, reports progress for the active cloud-dive plan

action.prompt:
A `tasks.md` file was just saved. Report progress for the active plan `.kiro/specs/cloud-dive/tasks.md` (read it even if a different tasks.md was saved; `.kiro/specs/aeroicing-watch/tasks.md` is the completed baseline and only needs a one-line count).

1. Count `[x]` and `[ ]` per section: P0 Eligibility, P1 Scored product and video, P2 Kiro depth, P3 Bonuses, Submission.
2. Active section = first section with an open task. Next task = first open task in it.
3. Note tasks newly checked since the previous report, if known.
4. Remind: every completed task needs a row in `docs/kiro-usage-log.md`.

Format:
## 📊 Cloud Dive — Task Progress
**Overall:** X / Y (N%) · **Days to deadline (2026-12-04):** D
| Section | Status | Done / Total |
**Active section:** ... **Next task:** ...
**Baseline (aeroicing-watch):** X / Y
> ✅ **Just completed:** ... (only if something was newly checked)
Keep it short. Do not invent completions.
